scripts.build:connectors: tsc -p connectors/generic-mssql/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/rahkaran/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/chargoon/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/shauto/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/sepidar/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/payamgostar/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/odoo/tsconfig.json && tsc -p connectors/csv-excel/tsconfig.json
